capabilities: replace the empty new-tab view with a customizable dashboard
show seasonal or custom backgrounds, a clock, a greeting, and a quote
search via a configurable search provider
display bookmarks and the five most recently edited notes
style each element with reusable text styles
extras: Listing note says the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; detailed configuration and troubleshooting docs live in separate docs/ files, and a one-click BeautiTab configuration import is offered.
intentEvidence: This is a personal version of, and derived from, obsidian-beautitab by Andrew McGivery (MIT).
motivation: The author built a personal version of BeautiTab, with several fixes from Mara-Li's maintained fork informing the new plugin.
problem: Obsidian opens an empty, uninformative view in every new tab, offering no at-a-glance dashboard or quick entry points.

relations.evidence: This plugin is derived from obsidian-beautitab by Andrew McGivery, used under the MIT License.
several of her fixes informed this one
Background images are served by Unsplash
built-in online quotes come from the ZenQuotes API

summary: New-tab dashboard that replaces Obsidian's empty new-tab view with backgrounds, a clock, greeting, quote, search, bookmarks, and recent files.
